name: InnoDB 状态变量监控诊断
description: InnoDB 状态变量是 MySQL 性能监控的核心数据源。关键分三组：Buffer Pool 组（Innodb_buffer_pool_reads/read_requests/pages_free/pages_dirty）反映内存效率；行操作组（Innodb_rows_read/inserted/updated/deleted）反映工作负载；日志组（Innodb_log_waits/writes/os_log_written）反映写入压力。通过 performance_schema.global_status 采集，计算速率和比率是监控的核心方法。

signals.desc: InnoDB 核心状态变量集合
performance_schema.global_status 中的 InnoDB 指标

skip_when.desc: 实例刚启动 < 10 分钟，指标尚未稳定
只读从库且无性能问题

root_causes.name: Buffer Pool 相关指标异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_buffer_pool_reads 持续升高表示物理读增加（命中率低）。pages_free = 0 表示内存不足。pages_dirty 过高可能导致 checkpoint 压力。wait_free > 0 表示前台线程等待空闲页。

root_causes.name: 行操作指标异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_rows_read 速率突增可能是新上线的大查询。rows_updated/deleted 突增可能是批量操作。row_lock_waits/row_lock_time 反映锁竞争程度。

root_causes.name: Redo Log 指标异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_log_waits > 0 表示 redo log 空间不足。Innodb_os_log_written 的速率反映写入吞吐量。log_pending_writes > 0 表示 IO 瓶颈。

root_causes.name: 数据操作指标异常
root_causes.desc: Innodb_data_reads/writes 反映磁盘 IO 总量。Innodb_data_pending_reads/writes > 0 表示 IO 排队。Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs > 0 表示 fsync 瓶颈。

step1_buffer_pool_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_data', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_wait_free', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_made_young', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_made_not_young')

step2_row_operations.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_rows_read', 'Innodb_rows_inserted', 'Innodb_rows_updated', 'Innodb_rows_deleted', 'Innodb_row_lock_waits', 'Innodb_row_lock_time', 'Innodb_row_lock_current_waits')

step3_log_status.desc: Redo Log 和 IO 指标
step3_log_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_log_waits', 'Innodb_log_writes', 'Innodb_log_write_requests', 'Innodb_os_log_written', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_writes', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs')

step4_data_io.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_data_reads', 'Innodb_data_writes', 'Innodb_data_read', 'Innodb_data_written', 'Innodb_data_pending_reads', 'Innodb_data_pending_writes', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_pending_fsyncs')

step5_hit_ratio_calc.desc: 计算 Buffer Pool 命中率
step5_hit_ratio_calc.sql: SELECT ROUND((1 - s1.VARIABLE_VALUE / GREATEST(s2.VARIABLE_VALUE, 1)) * 100, 4) AS hit_ratio_pct FROM performance_schema.global_status s1, performance_schema.global_status s2 WHERE s1.VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads' AND s2.VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'

real_world_examples.scenario: 通过 InnoDB 状态变量提前发现 Buffer Pool 不足
real_world_examples.symptoms: 监控发现 Innodb_buffer_pool_reads 速率从 10/s 涨到 500/s，但业务尚未明显感知
real_world_examples.root_cause: 新功能上线后热数据工作集增大 30%，buffer pool 开始频繁淘汰
real_world_examples.resolution: 在用户感知前将 buffer pool 从 8GB 调到 12GB
real_world_examples.result: 物理读速率回到 20/s，避免了一次性能事故
